verdict: Organic traffic is rising, but paid ads and key milestones remain unresolved.
narrative: Your site drew 7,850 sessions this period with zero paid ad support — and week-over-week sessions grew 10%, a sign that organic interest in Billy Doe Meats is real and building. At the same time, no paid spend has run across Meta or Google Ads during this entire period, which means that rising interest is not being captured or converted by any active campaign. Five planned milestones — including the Pre-Launch Gate, Funnel Test, and SEO Phase 1 — were due by August 31 and remain open; resolving these is the direct path to getting ads live. We're working through each blocker now, with the goal of having paid channels active before the next reporting window.
